provenance.method: Galois descent to Q(w3), then exhaustive three-pivot scan of seven-state configurations in exact arithmetic, batched and attested

compute.hardware: Apple silicon laptop, four loop.py instances at nice 19 over the 459-batch partition, 21 ns per inner step averaged

notes: With the verified rank-8 witness this settles chi(T3^3) = 8. A rank-7 decomposition would be seven independent stabilizer states whose images modulo V_3 span four dimensions; the three-pivot scan in orbit-block order with Stab(i, j) masks (docs/notes/t3_rank7_exclusion.md) lists every candidate class set and decides exactly, mod 2^31 - 1 under the Hadamard bound, whether V_3 lies in its span. 1,213,458,815 class sets over 459 batches, none containing V_3, none spurious or undecided. The rare-type pivot lemma that would have cut the scan 28x is false (docs/notes/t3_rank7_rare_pivot.md). Cost 80 CPU-hours at 21 ns per step; batch outputs, partition and manifests are committed under research/t3_rank7/, and aggregate.py re-derives any batch from scratch. Attested rather than reproduced because no certificate budget re-runs the enumeration; a faster kernel or an independent re-run elsewhere would lift the tier.
